flags.name: Flag 1
flags.description: From the Event Search view, set your time range 3 to 72 hours and clear your search 2. The SDL Search Helper makes it easy to quickly create queries, providing autocomplete and search for operators, functions, and fields. Clear your search 2, then type dataSource into the search bar. You will see a list of fields that include this term. Click dataSource.vendor to add the field to your query. The Search Helper will then show a list of vendors that are producing logs in the console. The flag is the approximate number of logs originating from Cloudflare.

flags.name: Flag 2
flags.description: From the Event Search view, set your time range 3 to 72 hours and clear your search 2. The SDL Search Helper makes it easy to quickly create queries, providing autocomplete and search for operators, functions, and fields. Clear your search 2, then type dataSource into the search bar. You will see a list of fields that include this term. Click dataSource.vendor to add the field to your query. The Search Helper will then show a list of comparison operators. Choose the = operator, then select Cloudflare from the list. Click Search to run the search. Then use the Fields 4 list to see the top destination ports. The flag is the source ip address with the most amount of Connections.
